title: TX machines
author: hugz202 (AE-analog-rytm-mods); MKII port: Iced-Cream
description: The Machinedrum's TX machines on the analog voices, ported from the MK1 mod. BD TX-9 (LEV PTC DEC TUN DPT ACC WAV ATK) and BD TX-9 DIGI run BD CLASSIC on the BD track with the TX-9's sweep, hold, decay and accent computed every audio block plus its click; SD TX-9 (LEV PTC DEC TON SNP ACC BND DTU) and SD TX-8 (LEV PTC DEC TON SNP ACC DET TRA) run SD CLASSIC on the SD track plus their own noise; XT TX-9 and XT TX-8 (TYP picks LT, MT or HT tuning) run XT CLASSIC on the MT/HT voices; BT TX-8 runs on the BT voice with its own hold and noise. They sit in the hidden machine slots 36 to 42 through core-ar2 0.5's machine table, and their knobs are those slots' parameter records, so a sound stores them as any machine's; a kit naming them loads on a build without the mod with that track set to DISABLE. Port of AE-analog-rytm-mods 0009-tx-machines (Analog Rytm MK1).
